svg.aria-label: Anzu, a free Windows app: your Kindle books, as EPUB. Three books with a lock leave the Kindle app one by one, pass through Anzu where each goes from with DRM to unlocked to EPUB ready, and land as EPUB files in the folder Documents\EPUB, ready to open on any reader. It asks before closing Kindle, stops and tells you why, needs no Calibre or command line, and never changes your Kindle folder.

text.tspan: A free Windows app that finds the books in
your Kindle app and saves each as an EPUB.
